banner.changelog_v1_0_1: Smoke-test fixes per the four-bug precedent (all pre-bank, on the received dumps): (1) attribution/assessment/advisory markers added to the goal-frame immunity class (claim/assess/compare/message/convey/expectation/feasibility/consult/recommend...) - a value that is the OBJECT of an assessment stays a goal; (2) goal-frame window widened 10->12 tokens (the fails-open direction); (3) the committed-answer idiom recognized as an assertion slot that overrides goal-frame immunity - v2 refinement: the value must be INSIDE the slot (within \boxed{...} braces or starting within 30 chars after a 'final answer' phrase); proximity alone does not assert; (4) M4 P2 oracle accounting (P2 reads every doc) and per-slice M2 buckets fixed; (5) P1 json extraction switched to a balanced-brace scan (the greedy first-to-last brace match misread fenced JSON as a parse failure). Drafting the requested artifact does NOT confer immunity - the authored claim is the model's own commitment (the V2 gap-bridging class).
banner.measurements: M1″-M5″ per §6; readings R-P1-R-P5 presented, never adjudicated here

conventions_first_pass.derived_slip: NOT mechanically resolvable this pass (needs arith-* conventions, fixture phase); fails open, censused
